title: Federated Community Detection in Bipartite Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.25997v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study federated spectral estimation when a large matrix is horizontally partitioned across servers that cannot share raw data. We propose FLICKER, a target-specific gradient-based power iteration that recovers a singular direction associated with a prescribed spectral target using only matrix-vector products on local blocks. Different target directions can be recovered independently and in parallel. We establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees and provide a recursive grid-search procedure for spectral target selection. Building on FLICKER, we develop BiFLICKER for federated community detection in bipartite networks, together with a sequential projected variant for nearby or repeated singular directions. Under a sparse bipartite stochastic block model, we show that properly rescaled leading singular values from a reference server provide valid global targets, and that Sequential BiFLICKER achieves a vanishing miscluster

translated_title: 二部网络中的联邦社区检测
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当一个大矩阵被水平划分到无法共享原始数据的多台服务器上时的联邦谱估计问题。我们提出了FLICKER，一种针对特定目标的基于梯度的幂迭代方法，它仅通过在本地数据块上执行矩阵-向量乘积，即可恢复与预定谱目标相关联的奇异方向。不同的目标方向可以独立且并行地恢复。我们建立了非渐近收敛保证，并提供了一种用于谱目标选择的递归网格搜索程序。基于FLICKER，我们开发了用于二部网络联邦社区检测的BiFLICKER，并针对相近或重复的奇异方向提出了顺序投影变体。在稀疏二部随机块模型下，我们证明了来自参考服务器的经过适当缩放的主奇异值可以提供有效的全局目标，并且顺序BiFLICKER实现了趋近于零的误聚类率。
tldr: 提出FLICKER与BiFLICKER方法，在原始数据不可共享的联邦环境下实现了二部网络的谱估计与社区检测，并提供了非渐近收敛与误聚类率的理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes FLICKER and BiFLICKER, enabling federated spectral estimation and community detection in bipartite networks without sharing raw data, with non-asymptotic convergence and misclustering guarantees.
